title: Stacking Strategist: Bitcoin DCA plan and fee comparison | Virtuse
description: Plan a regular Bitcoin buy, see a scenario projection and what each partner's fee costs you a year. From €10 a month to €1,000,000 upfront.
og_title: Stacking Strategist: Bitcoin DCA plan and fee comparison
lead: Set an amount, a rhythm and a time frame. You see a scenario projection and what the fee at each partner costs you every year.
noscript: Stacking Strategist needs JavaScript. You can compare buy fees on the Fee Index.
s1_p: A lump sum, a weekly or monthly amount and how many years you want to buy.
s2_p: Three return scenarios show a range, not a forecast. Bitcoin can also lose value.
s3_p: What the listed fee at each partner costs you a year at your amount. You choose where to buy.
a1: No. The returns are scenarios to show a range. Past performance doesn't guarantee future results, and Bitcoin can fall in value.
a2: No. The comparison uses each partner's listed fee. The Fee Index adds the estimated spread for total cost.
q3: Why can I enter up to €1,000,000?
a3: For larger allocations there is Virtuse CFO · Verdict. Check for free what you left out of your decision. The CFO then tracks fees and risks. Verdict and the fee audit are free from 1 November. Paid plans from January: €9/month or €90/year.
a4: No. You buy directly at the partner you choose. Virtuse never holds your keys or funds.
rel_fee_p: Total cost of buying Bitcoin every month.
rel_dca_p: Fees on a regular plan, year one.
rel_buy_p: Buy partners and their fees, side by side.
rel_cfo_p: Check for free what you left out of your decision. The CFO then tracks fees and risks.
rel_data_p: Price, fees and network data, live.
rel_ret_p: When Bitcoin savings could fund your retirement.
disclaimer: Scenarios, not forecasts. Not investment advice. Virtuse never holds your keys or funds; you buy on each partner's platform.
